packs.name: SNAFU & CO
packs.description: WWII-era government animation: all 26 released Private Snafu shorts (Warner crew, Dr. Seuss scripts, Mel Blanc), the Mr. Hook Navy trio, and three Warner-made government shorts including the Oscar-winning So Much for So Little.
packs.contentNote: Adult-oriented WWII military training humor: innuendo, pin-ups, wartime propaganda, and period racial caricature of Axis nations. Presented as history. Not for the kids' lineup — leave off any kid-safe channel list.
